entries.brief: Original SKAZ D&D2014 fantasy reference-book spell illustration. Mature painterly realism, restrained natural colors, strong compact silhouette readable at32px on both dark navy and cream backgrounds, generous transparent margins. Single centered motif, no text, no UI, no border, no cartoon, no noisy scene. Symbol spell: one dark ancient stone plaque bearing a faint abstract magical seal (not readable writing), suddenly surrounded by a violet spherical halo as a gloved fingertip approaches. Compact plaque and touch trigger, no book, no text.

review.notes: Local IAB32/40px, grayscale circle, Polaris/Coal/Atlas. Six spell motifs checked against 2014 catalog descriptions.
